issues: [critical] Step requirement '检查或创建 task/goal.md' not fulfilled. File was not found and was not created. -> Create the task/goal.md file with appropriate project goals as required by the step definition.

[critical] Duplicate controller files identified but not cleaned up. Both kebab-case and camelCase versions exist (auth-controller.ts/authController.ts, task-controller.ts/taskController.ts). Step requires: '选择 kebab-case 版本并删除另一个版本，更新所有相关导入'. -> 1) Keep auth-controller.ts and task-controller.ts (kebab-case). 2) Delete authController.ts and taskController.ts. 3) Update all import statements across the codebase that reference the deleted files.

[major] Error handling standardization incomplete. Controllers use inconsistent patterns: some throw errors via createAppError (in services), others return error objects in responses. Step requires: '确保所有服务和控制器使用 createAppError 抛出错误而非返回错误对象'. -> Refactor controllers to not return error objects but let errors propagate to error middleware. Ensure all services throw createAppError instances, and controllers should not handle specific error codes in try-catch blocks but let them propagate to the error handler.

[minor] Service function signatures differ between controller versions. authController.ts calls authService.getCurrentUser() while auth-controller.ts calls authService.getUserById(). This indicates inconsistent service APIs. -> Standardize the service API after deleting duplicate files. Ensure consistent function names and signatures across the remaining codebase.

[minor] Directory structure 'src/' creation mentioned but not explicitly shown. Step says: '创建目标目录 src/（如不存在）'. -> Verify if src/ directory exists at root level or if only server/src/ exists. Create src/ if needed as specified.
